stories.title: Double yellow lines proposed around Oakenholt school
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council says the lines would stop parked cars blocking junctions and a roundabout near the school.

stories.title: 200 new food businesses recorded in Flintshire in a year
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council recorded 200 new food businesses in the year to the end of March, and 29 were still waiting for a first hygiene inspection. Seven of the 29 were overdue. stories.title: Flintshire heatwave put bin crews at risk during missed collections
stories.summary: A spate of missed bin collections in Flintshire this summer was due in part to concerns about the health of bin crews. stories.title: Replacement buses for Flint and Shotton as North Wales Coast line closes for three weeks
stories.summary: No trains will call at Flint or Shotton on the North Wales Coast line for three weeks in January while Network Rail carries out £25m of engineering work.
